title: Implementar canary CI de la suite browser canónica de Facultad V18
mission: Implement a deterministic GitHub Actions/Playwright runner for the canonical Facultad V18 browser suite so repository workers can prepare and launch representative desktop+narrow browser evidence through CI without pretending their local runtime has browser capability. The CI canary must target the live V18 route and persist bounded evidence/artifacts.
definition_of_done: Add a deterministic browser test that opens the canonical live V18 page in representative desktop and narrow JavaScript contexts.

Assert the canonical suite criteria: Notas/date real-or-honest states, disabled generic-login honesty, Cronograma source matching/honest-empty behavior, Version anterior reachability and captured runtime errors.
Wire the test into a bounded GitHub Actions workflow or existing compatible verification workflow without changing publication pointers.
Persist machine-readable evidence plus screenshots or equivalent rendered artifacts sufficient for a later disposition.
Keep Current, Human Accepted and Served authority unchanged; CI evidence is technical verification only.
Do not mark portfolio-facultad-v18-browser-suite-v1 PASS until an actual CI/browser run provides the required runtime evidence.
